# Gallons delivered isn't profit. Margin per customer is.

> Free calculator for independent propane (LP gas) delivery route operators: find real annual profit per customer after the retail/wholesale price spread, the minimum-delivery fee on small fills, drive time and mileage, and tank rental and hazmat compliance cost, then see whether your whole route hits your income goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
